title: TIDE: Trajectory-Informed Skill Distillation for Efficient Text-to-Video Prompt Optimization
title_zh: TIDE：基于轨迹的技能蒸馏，用于高效文本到视频提示优化

paragraphs.en: Text-to-video (T2V) models are highly sensitive to prompt specificity, while iterative prompt optimization typically improves generation quality only through repeated video generation and vision-language model evaluation at inference time. We propose TIDE, a framework that distills this costly search process into an interpretable and reusable prompt-rewriting Skill. TIDE formulates prompt rewriting as a set of source-conditioned rule modules, each targeting a distinct semantic dimension. Once distilled, the frozen Skill activates the relevant rules and generates both positive and negative prompts in a single LLM call, followed by only one T2V generation, without test-time visual search or backbone fine-tuning. Evolved using only 100 prompts over 14 hours, TIDE achieves prompt-optimization performance comparable to computationally expensive search-based methods. Moreover, when transferred to previously unseen video-generation models, TIDE outperforms existing approaches specifically designed or trained for those models. Code is available here .
paragraphs.zh: 文本到视频（T2V）模型对提示词的具体性极为敏感，而迭代式提示词优化通常仅在推理阶段通过重复生成视频以及进行视觉-语言模型评估来提升生成质量。 我们提出了 TIDE——一个将这一成本高昂的搜索过程提炼为可解释且可重用的提示词重写“技能”的框架。 TIDE 将提示词重写构建为一组以输入为条件的规则模块，每个模块针对一个独特的语义维度。 一旦完成提炼，该固化“技能”即可在一次大型语言模型调用中激活相关规则并生成正向与负向提示词，随后仅需一次 T2V 生成，无需测试时的视觉搜索或主干模型微调。 TIDE 仅用 100 个提示词经过 14 小时演化，便实现了与计算成本高昂的搜索类方法相当的提示词优化性能。 此外，当迁移至此前未接触过的视频生成模型时，TIDE 的表现优于专为这些模型设计或训练的现有方法。代码可在此处获取。

paragraphs.en: Video generation has advanced rapidly in recent years, catalyzed by the emergence of Sora [ 2 ] . Building on this momentum, models [ 3 , 16 , 8 , 1 ] can generate visually compelling and temporally coherent videos from text. Their broad applicability—from advertising and creative design to film production and world simulation—has begun to yield real-world deployments and emerging commercial applications, underscoring the field’s substantial practical potential.

paragraphs.en: However, a gap remains between users’ concise prompts and the detailed descriptions needed to fully exploit these models, motivating prompt optimization for video generation. One-shot methods use an LLM with a fixed prompting strategy or handcrafted templates to rewrite or augment prompts efficiently at inference time [ 14 , 21 ] . A complementary line amortizes optimization by training prompt rewriters offline on curated or optimized prompts using supervised, reinforcement-learning, or preference-based objectives [ 9 , 4 , 10 , 6 , 7 ] . These paradigms lack direct visual feedback at inference time and therefore cannot adapt to prompt-specific generation failures. More recent approaches perform dynamic, test-time optimization using feedback from generated visual content [ 15 , 13 ] : they repeatedly generate candidates, assess their quality, and revise prompts until satisfactory results are obtained. In T2V generation, this feedback-driven process adapts to each prompt, is generally agnostic to the underlying generator, and often achieves stronger optimization than one-shot rewriting. These advantages come at a steep computational cost, however, as repeated video generation and model calls can take hours for a single prompt while producing only seconds of video.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，用户简洁的提示与充分利用这些模型所需的详细描述之间仍存在差距，这推动了视频生成领域的提示优化。 单样本方法使用具有固定提示策略或人工设计模板的大型语言模型（LLM），在推理阶段高效地重写或扩展提示 [ 14 , 21 ] 。 一种互补的方法则通过离线训练提示重写器来摊销优化成本，这些提示重写器基于精选或优化的提示，并使用监督学习、强化学习或偏好相关的目标函数进行训练 [ 9 , 4 , 10 , 6 , 7 ] 。 这些范式在推理阶段缺乏直接的视觉反馈，因此无法针对特定提示的生成失败进行调整。 较新的方法则利用生成视觉内容的反馈，在测试阶段执行动态优化 [ 15 , 13 ]：它们会反复生成候选结果、评估其质量，并修改提示，直到获得令人满意的结果。 在文本到视频（T2V）生成中，这种以反馈驱动的过程能够适应每个提示，通常与底层生成器无关，并且往往比单样本重写方法实现更强的优化效果。 然而，这些优势也伴随着高昂的计算成本，因为重复的视频生成和模型调用可能因单个提示而耗时数小时，最终却只能产出几秒钟的视频。

paragraphs.en: This trade-off motivates our central question: Can the experience accumulated during iterative optimization be retained in a compact artifact, so that a subsequent one-shot rewrite can achieve the benefits of iterative search? Rather than learning solely from offline optimized prompt pairs, we distill experience into an interpretable and reusable prompt-rewriting Skill. Unlike prompt-pair fine-tuning, which typically supervises only the initial and optimized endpoints, our approach also distills intermediate critiques, suggestions, candidate comparisons, and dimension-specific corrections from each trajectory, yielding a richer supervision signal and making fuller use of the collected optimization experience. The resulting Skill is model-agnostic and exposes its learned behavior as explicit rewriting rules, while requiring only one LLM call and one video generation at inference time. We call this framework TIDE , which organizes the acquired knowledge into distinct semantic dimensions, including motion specification, camera framing, identity preservation, and other semantic aspects. Accordingly, we formulate the rewriting policy as independent, source-triggered rule modules, each targeting a specific aspect of prompt quality. As illustrated in Fig. 1 , we continuously mine dimension-specific patches from online-generated optimization trajectories to update its rule modules and synchronize them with the Skill.
paragraphs.zh: 这种权衡促使我们提出核心问题：迭代优化过程中积累的经验能否被保留在一种紧凑的产物中，从而使得后续的单次重写能够实现迭代搜索带来的优势？ 我们并非仅从离线的优化提示词对中学习，而是将经验提炼为一种可解释且可重用的提示词重写技能。 与通常仅监督初始和最终优化结果的提示词对微调不同，我们的方法还从每条轨迹中提炼出中间阶段的批评、建议、候选项比较以及特定维度的修正，从而获得更丰富的监督信号，并更充分地利用所收集的优化经验。 由此产生的技能具有模型无关性，并以显式重写规则的形式暴露其学习到的行为，同时在推理阶段仅需一次 LLM 调用和一次视频生成。 我们将这一框架称为 TIDE，它将获取的知识组织为独立的语义维度，包括动作规格、镜头构图、身份保留及其他语义方面。 因此，我们将重写策略设计为独立且由源输入触发的规则模块，每个模块针对提示词质量的特定方面。 如图 1 所示，我们持续从在线生成的优化轨迹中挖掘特定维度的片段，以更新其规则模块并与技能同步。

paragraphs.en: Our trajectory-generation module, corresponding to stage (2) in Fig. 1 , adapts the prompt self-improvement procedure of VISTA [ 13 ] , retaining its visual feedback loop while discarding audio-specific components. paragraphs.en: Implementation Details. We evolve the prompt-rewriting Skill with SANA-Video-2B [ 5 ] , generating 5-second, 480p videos with 81 frames. DeepSeek-V4-Flash [ 11 ] handles text-only stages, including rewriting, candidate generation, trajectory distillation, and rule updates, while Qwen3.6-35B-A3B [ 22 ] evaluates videos sampled at 2 FPS for quality assessment, critique generation, and tournament selection. During the Trajectory Generation stage, we perform two optimization rounds, generating four candidate prompts in each round; a rule is updated after four dimension-specific patches accumulate. The Skill is evolved on 100 prompts collected from EvalCrafter [ 12 ] . Training takes 14 hours on four NVIDIA A100 GPUs, including 12.4 hours for trajectory collection.
paragraphs.zh: 实现细节。 我们使用 SANA-Video-2B [ 5 ] 演化提示词重写技能，生成时长为 5 秒、分辨率为 480p、包含 81 帧的视频。 DeepSeek-V4-Flash [ 11 ] 处理纯文本阶段，包括重写、候选生成、轨迹蒸馏和规则更新；而 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B [ 22 ] 则以 2 FPS 的采样率评估视频，用于质量评估、评论生成和锦标赛选择。 在轨迹生成阶段，我们执行两轮优化，每轮生成四个候选提示词；当累积四个特定维度的补丁后，规则会被更新一次。 该技能是在从 EvalCrafter [ 12 ] 收集的 100 个提示词上演化而来的。 训练过程在四块 NVIDIA A100 GPU 上耗时 14 小时，其中包括 12.4 小时的轨迹收集时间。

paragraphs.en: Evaluation Benchmarks. We draw evaluation prompts from VBench2 [ 24 ] and T2V-CompBench [ 19 ] . The VBench2 subset contains 431 canonical prompts across nine dimensions, while T2V-CompBench contains 200 prompts each for object interactions and generative numeracy. Unless otherwise specified, each prompt is rendered with three random seeds. paragraphs.en: Effective Distillation of Exploration Experience. As shown in Table 1 , even before trajectory distillation, Ours init \mathrm{Ours}_{\mathrm{init}} improves the average score over Raw prompts (77.91 vs. 75.72), demonstrating the effectiveness of the initial rewriting Skill. This result demonstrates that TIDE captures and distills the experience accumulated through VISTA’s multi-round iterative exploration into reusable rewriting rules, transferring its optimization benefits to a compact, single-pass Skill. While VISTA and Ours distil \mathrm{Ours}_{\mathrm{distil}} exhibit complementary strengths across different dimensions, the distilled Skill achieves the best overall performance without requiring test-time visual search.

paragraphs.en: Qualitative Results. Fig. 2 compares the optimized prompts and visual results. paragraphs.en: We ablate three key components of TIDE: rule selection, negative-prompt distillation, and anti-starvation scheduling. paragraphs.en: We introduce TIDE, a trajectory-informed framework that distills iterative text-to-video prompt optimization into an interpretable, reusable rewriting skill. By distilling iterative visual search, TIDE alleviates this trade-off: it retains the strong performance and model-agnostic applicability of iterative methods while replacing costly multi-round generation, evaluation, and revision with a single LLM rewrite and T2V generation, matching search-based optimization from only 100 prompts on a single backbone and surpassing methods designed or fine-tuned for unseen generators. Despite these advantages, TIDE still has limitations. Distilled from trajectories collected on a single backbone with a small prompt set, its rules leave rarely triggered dimensions under-refined and may encode backbone- or judge-specific biases. Future work will therefore explore learning from more diverse optimization trajectories to improve robustness, and extend TIDE to audio-aware video optimization.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 TIDE，一个基于轨迹的框架，它将迭代式文本到视频提示优化提炼为一种可解释且可重用的重写技能。 通过提炼迭代式视觉搜索，TIDE 缓解了这种权衡：它既保留了迭代方法强大的性能和模型无关的适用性，又将耗时的多轮生成、评估和修订替换为单次 LLM 重写和 T2V 生成；仅使用单一主干模型上的 100 个提示，其效果便与基于搜索的优化相当，并超越了为未知生成器设计或微调的方法。 尽管具有这些优势，TIDE 仍然存在局限性。 由于 TIDE 的规则是从单一主干模型和较小的提示集上收集的轨迹中提炼而来的，因此那些极少被触发的维度可能未被充分优化，并且规则本身可能编码了特定于主干模型或评估标准的偏见。 因此，未来的工作将探索从更多样化的优化轨迹中学习以提升鲁棒性，并将 TIDE 扩展到支持音频感知的视频优化。

sents.en: We introduce TIDE, a trajectory-informed framework that distills iterative text-to-video prompt optimization into an interpretable, reusable rewriting skill.

sents.en: By distilling iterative visual search, TIDE alleviates this trade-off: it retains the strong performance and model-agnostic applicability of iterative methods while replacing costly multi-round generation, evaluation, and revision with a single LLM rewrite and T2V generation, matching search-based optimization from only 100 prompts on a single backbone and surpassing methods designed or fine-tuned for unseen generators.

sents.en: Despite these advantages, TIDE still has limitations.
sents.zh: 尽管具有这些优势，TIDE 仍然存在局限性。

sents.en: Distilled from trajectories collected on a single backbone with a small prompt set, its rules leave rarely triggered dimensions under-refined and may encode backbone- or judge-specific biases.

sents.en: Future work will therefore explore learning from more diverse optimization trajectories to improve robustness, and extend TIDE to audio-aware video optimization.
